description:
Use this when you need an auditable Estonia working-day count. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when estonia 2026 statutory rest facts over an explicitly selected Monday-Friday planning baseline. Sixteen national-importance dates do not add rest. Four dates carry a conditional three-hour shortening rule but still count as one planning working date, not a half-day or full-day holiday. No substitute or bridge is invented. Individual shifts, actual working hours, opening hours, employer/local/sector/school/bank schedules, replacement weekly rest, payroll, legal deadlines and future years are not computed.
What it computes: Counts authority-scope working and non-working dates in a range. Requires explicit mon_fri_planning; national-importance dates and three-hour shortening never add full-day rest.
Example user requests: Count Estonia working days around Independence Day is statutory rest. | Count Estonia working days around Shortened working date is not full-day rest. | Count Estonia working days around National importance does not imply rest.
Inputs: start_date (date); end_date (date); include_start_date (boolean, optional); include_end_date (boolean, optional); work_schedule (enum).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2026-06-22","end_date":"2026-06-25","work_schedule":"mon_fri_planning"}
Outputs: working_days, non_working_days, public_holidays_counted, territory, territory_name, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources, work_schedule, is_statutory_non_working_day, is_day_of_national_importance, is_shortened_workday, statutory_shortening_hours, shortening_scope, working_hours_scope, personal_roster_scope, payroll_scope, shortened_work_dates_counted, shortened_work_date_count.
Formula: planning_workday = weekday AND no statutory_full_day_rest_event; shortened working dates count once
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/estonia-public-working-days-between with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/estonia-public-working-days-between.md

work_schedule.description: Required explicit Monday-Friday planning baseline; not an individual legal roster.

name: count_ee_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Estonia 2026 statutory rest and conditional shortening facts with explicit Monday-Friday planning baseline

day_type.description: national_holiday_rest, public_holiday_rest, shortened_workday, weekend_baseline or regular_workday; observances do not add rest.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

is_day_of_national_importance.description: Whether result.date is a PTS section 3 observance without extra rest.

is_shortened_workday.description: Whether result.date carries the conditional ECA 53 shortening rule; not full-day rest.

is_statutory_non_working_day.description: Whether result.date is a statutory full-day rest holiday under PTS sections 1-2, excluding ordinary weekends.

public_holidays_counted.description: Event dates including non-rest observances and shortening; list length is not a full-day holiday count.

shortened_work_date_count.description: Count of included shortened dates, not hours.

shortened_work_dates_counted.description: Included shortened dates, each already counted as one working day.

statutory_shortening_hours.description: Three on a shortening-rule date, zero otherwise. Rule magnitude only, NOT computed individual hours or entitlement.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Count Estonia Working Days
